Score

Box Scores

Week 10. Three owners posted season highs.

Ferries 173.9, Tom 114.4

A season high for the Ferries, and six-tenths short of the $20. Tom falls to 3-7.

Ricer 170.3, Craig 123.6

Ricer's best score of the year, and he's 8-2. Craig has lost three straight.

Rusty 174.5, Frenches 150.7

Rusty's season high took the week and his first $20 of the year. Most points in the league, still 4-6. The Frenches have dropped two straight.

Giff 123.9, Abeln 107.8

Four straight for Giff. Abeln has lost eight in a row.

Schwanz 125.9, Chad 75.2

Chad's 75.2 was the low of the week and his worst of the season. Schwanz has won seven straight.

The Gum Low score of the week: Chad, 75.2. Stale, pink, breaks on contact.
